subjects.name: NESARA and the Mark of the Beast

summary: A reading of NESARA and the Mark of the Beast, a short book by Tulsa audiologist Scott Young that blends COVID vaccine microchip fears, end-times Christianity, QAnon-style cabal claims and the NESARA debt-forgiveness myth.

evidence.note: author introduced as an audiologist running a hearing clinic in Tulsa
book repeats COVID origin and CDC death-toll conspiracy claims
vaccine microchip theory tied to the Mark of the Beast
late-1990s barcode and chip panic discussed as background to the author
NESARA background chapter: debt claims, Fourteenth Amendment, Federal Reserve
satanic cabal and World Settlement Fund claims
host traces NESARA from about 2000 through its 2004 slump to QAnon today

notes: Second half of a two-part NESARA story; this part is a book reading. Author's birth year unknown, so floruit 2021 is used. Covered span start is an estimate for NESARA's late-1990s origins discussed in the host's commentary; the book itself is a 2020-2021 text. fraud-grift rests on the hosts framing the book as a grift.
